finding.text: Finished Servex rows show no stop time, and their Duration keeps growing (requirement 3). An idle reviewer that finished minutes ago reads Stop "—" and Duration equal to its Start age (6m/6m, 8m/8m, … 15m/15m). The reason: `Agents.js` sets `stopped_at` only on an explicit stop (line 542), never when a run finishes, so `row_view` measures to *now*. Evidence: shots/…/1920.png, rows 1–5.

Cost is not on every row (requirement 3). The CLI/VS Code rows have an empty Cost cell (shots/…/1920.png, the "monorepo" rows), and at 1200 the Cost column is off the right edge of the grid entirely (shots/…/1200.png, the header ends at RAM).

The ask "The Sessions tab lists from those pages (the day indexes)" is only half built (requirement 2). `session_page_dir_index()` can change a row's *link*, but every row still comes from `sessions.json`. A session that has only a date-path page will never appear as a row. Listing from the day indexes is the part the owner named.

The `ai/sessions/transcripts/` folder (110 files) still exists in the main checkout. It is removed only when `sessions.mjs` next runs. The owner's "delete the copy folder" is done in the worktree but not yet on disk here. Run the script once after the merge.

At 400, Start, Stop and Duration print as bare numbers side by side ("6m — 6m", "8d 16m 213h 50m"). Without their headers, a reader can't tell which number is which (content). shots/…/400.png, row band.
Every width logs one 404 (layout.json `errors`). Name the resource, or confirm it is the expected `week.json` miss.
The `.claude/hooks/syntax-guard.mjs` change is outside the brief's scope. It is recorded in decisions.md, so it is noted here, not blocked.
